name: nodekeeper
description: Orquestador raíz de NodeKeeper. No es un paquete publicable ni agrega dependencias propias; solo reenvía comandos a backend/ y frontend/.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:migrate: npm --prefix backend exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.verify: npm run db:validate && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run build
